K6.gap_reason:
The cell still fails after the header fix, for two reasons:
(1) Tokens are plaintext at rest. SEC-04 was closed as an accepted risk in WRITEUP, and the brief says not to change token storage. Closing it needs an owner decision row.
(2) /p cannot take no-referrer without a regression users notice. Its Yes/No/reschedule buttons are native form POSTs that work without JavaScript. Under no-referrer, Chromium sends Origin: null and Next aborts the Server Action; reproduced on a production build, where the confirmation stayed pending. Owner options: accept a JavaScript-only portal; keep same-origin (no Referer to other sites) and record it; or add a Sec-Fetch-Site origin shim, which changes CSRF handling.
